התהליך היום: Confirm vehicle meets US FMVSS standards
Israel only accepts US, Canadian, or European-standard vehicles
Verify the specific model is approved for import to Israel
Check with a certified Israeli importer — some models are blocked even if they meet standards
Confirm vehicle has ESP / ESC (Electronic Stability Control)
Required by Israeli standards. If Mobileye is absent it must be installed before customs release
Check your personal import tax status (Oleh vs. regular citizen)
Olim: ~75% tax (50% purchase tax + 18% VAT). Regular citizens: ~100%+ on purchase price
Ensure vehicle age is within the allowed import window
Generally under 4 years old from manufacture date; exceptions exist depending on vehicle type
Purchase vehicle and obtain clear title (no liens, no lease)
Title must be in the importer's name; leased vehicles cannot be imported
Ensure seller is OK to deal with corporation and OK to sell for import
Obtain original CARFAX report with full vehicle history
Required for all US vehicles manufactured after 1980
Obtain original purchase invoice with full vehicle details
Must include: manufacturer, model, year, engine number, chassis number, engine capacity
Prepare notarized affidavit that car has no accident history / shield damage
Customs (Meches) may require this — best to prepare proactively
Get letter from an Israeli garage confirming ability to service the vehicle
Required before customs clearance — the garage must confirm access to original parts
Apply for Israeli personal import license from Ministry of Transport
Submit via gov.il — requires Israeli driver's license, vehicle details, COC, and compliance proofs
Choose shipping method: RoRo or container
RoRo (~$1,500–$2,500) is cheaper; container (~$2,500–$3,500) offers more protection
Book a licensed freight forwarder / car shipping company
Responsible for transport to port, loading, Bill of Lading
Required for Meches valuation; retain all insurance invoices
Thoroughly clean vehicle inside and out before shipping
Israeli quarantine regulations require a clean vehicle on arrival
Submit Meches declaration form (form 21) + all documents
Can be done via licensed customs agent or in person at a Meches office
Meches appraisal: customs appraiser assesses vehicle value (CIF basis)
You can appeal the valuation in writing if the declared price is disputed
Arrange Arvut Bankai (bank guarantee) for unpaid taxes
Bank sends guarantee forms directly to Meches; renewed annually; costs a few hundred NIS/year
Pay customs duties and purchase tax + 18% VAT
Regular citizen: ~83% purchase tax + 18% VAT. Oleh: ~50% + 18% VAT
Install Mobileye if not already present (required before release)
Can be arranged at port area installers before customs releases the vehicle
Receive invitation for standardization check (within ~2 weeks of customs release)
Misrad Hatachbura's Personal Imports Division is notified automatically by Meches
Pass standardization inspection (identity check, Israeli standards compliance)
Check can take up to 2 months to complete; vehicle may not be drivable until passed
Obtain metric speedometer confirmation and headlight compliance (standard T0211001)
Required if not already present on US-spec vehicle
Register vehicle at Misrad Harishui (Vehicle Licensing Bureau)
Bring Meches certification and bank guarantee confirmation
Pass initial roadworthiness inspection (test) if vehicle is over 3 years old
New vehicles are exempt from inspection for first 3 years
